decks.notes: This deck focuses on a fast-paced, aggressive strategy utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful threat. The deck includes a combination of disruption, card draw, and removal to support the main game plan of reducing your own life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow. Additional cards like Reanimate and Brazen Borrower provide flexibility and additional threats to keep the pressure on opponents. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and card advantage throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly dump powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back into play using various reanimation spells. Cards like Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Grief help put creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard, while cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead bring them back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption cards like Unmask and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It is a fast and efficient combo deck that aims to win the game quickly with high-powered creatures.

The main focus of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Aggro-Death's Shadow deck is to quickly put pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost threats like Delver of Secrets and Death's Shadow, while disrupting their plays with cards like Thoughtseize and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Snuff Out, while also maintaining card advantage through Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of cards like Reanimate and Murktide Regent allow for explosive plays and a strong late-game presence. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for efficient deployment of spells.

This Jeskai Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler alongside disruptive spells such as Force of Will and Daze to control the pace of the game. By using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with opposing threats, while protecting its own creatures with counterspells and removal, this aggro deck aims to win through a combination of card advantage, tempo advantage, and aggressive plays.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on early aggression and disruption using cheap spells like Lightning Bolt, Daze, and Force of Will to control the board and protect threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes efficient cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm to filter through the deck and find key pieces. With a mix of threats and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and maintain control of the game with a lean mana base and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bringing them back to the battlefield with Reanimate. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Narset, Parter of Veils to control the game while setting up the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and deadly reanimation strategy, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to achieve victory.

This deck focuses on using the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire deck at once. The deck also uses various artifact tutors and recursion effects to assemble the combo quickly and protect it from removal, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and burn spells. Additionally, the deck can generate mana quickly with mana rocks and lands like Ancient Tomb to play threats like Karn, the Great Creator or close out games with aggressive creatures like Phyrexian Dragon Engine.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and opponent's resources through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. By using cards like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as versatile removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful card draw effects like Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain consistency and stay ahead in card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Snapcaster Mage and Kolaghan's Command further add utility and flexibility to the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells while disrupting their resources with counterspells and land destruction. By combining aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent with powerful removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and close out matches before the opponent can fully develop their game plan. The inclusion of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder allows for consistent card advantage and manipulation to ensure the deck runs smoothly.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library. The deck focuses on utilizing land-based interactions such as Crop Rotation and Knight of the Reliquary to search for key lands like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to assemble the powerful combo. With cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending for removal, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and control the game until it can assemble its win condition.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and blue spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast pace of play. By combining aggressive artifact creatures with efficient counterspells and powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Emry, Lurker of the Loch acts as a powerful recurring threat, while Thoughtcast and Urza's Bauble provide card advantage and help maintain tempo. The deck is designed to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their strategy and gaining incremental advantages.

The deck focuses on creating a fast-paced, aggressive strategy by utilizing artifact creatures and a variety of artifacts to control the board and quickly overwhelm the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan through cards like Chalice of the Void and Pithing Needle, while also drawing cards efficiently with Thoughtcast and Mishra's Bauble. The combination of creature threats like Sai, Master Thopterist and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, along with powerful artifacts like Shadowspear and Urza's Saga, allows the deck to apply pressure and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on using control elements such as counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive planeswalkers to delay opponents' game plans while generating card advantage. The main win condition is through recurring threats like Uro and The One Ring to eventually overpower the opponent. The deck also utilizes a small land destruction package with cards like Wasteland and Life from the Loam to disrupt mana bases. The deck aims to efficiently control the game until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game decisively.

This deck focuses on assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. It utilizes cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal for fast mana, along with Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor for card draw. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Urza's Saga can help find key artifacts, while Emry, Lurker of the Loch provides recursion for artifacts. The aim is to quickly set up the combo and win the game through milling.

This Grixis Aggro deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying constant pressure with efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck uses disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the game, while creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent quickly close out the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out to deal with threats. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere, while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to apply pressure. The deck aims to lock the opponent out of casting spells effectively while beating them down with powerful creatures. The inclusion of Dragon Stompy cards like Magus of the Moon and Fury add additional disruption and reach to close out the game efficiently.
